description: Storage for consumer modules (ADR-029): NFS shares declared in config/shares.json through storage-manager, served by the cluster nodes, mounted into consumer guests by storage:nfs. A virtual module, like cluster — nothing of its own to install.
_virtual: Like cluster: registered (config/storage.json) so the dispatcher can resolve storage:nfs, but it installs nothing on any machine. The shares themselves are Site state in config/shares.json, owned by storage-manager (tappaas-cicd/manager/storage-manager); the cluster nodes serve them through their NFS server hook (pvehost/storage/nfs-server.sh). ADR-029 v0.9 D1.
